title: The Lyons Brothers bring the Spirits west; the marijuana bust and quitting pot
summary: The Lyons brothers took the Spirits from the Hickory House to Hollywood where all were jailed 45 days over one joint; Bunn quit pot afterward.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: That's right. A man comes all the way to New York. We was working at the Hickory House, the Spirits.
Working at the Hickory House. He come all the way from here to New York after this group, the Spirits of Rhythm, and brought us back here.

Had a bar and grill here in town, in California, in Hollywood. And the first thing they did when they got out here was get caught on account of a guy selling weed in the toilet. We bought weed and got locked up with it. Because the boy that worked in there was selling it. And we,
like a damn fool, bought it from him. He didn't do no time. We did the time. I done 45 days, and the rest of the boys done 45 days. For one joint.
A lot of states -- you know, nowadays a lot of states that's a misdemeanor.
In fact there's even a town, in Wisconsin I think, they made it into almost like a joke. It's a $5.00 fine.
Times -- you say time brings about a change.
It brought about a big change.
Some places, you've got to watch, like Texas. You can get in still pretty severe -- so it doesn't --
To even have a little roach.
Do you think some people play better when they're stoned? Or do you think it's like a fantasy?
It's a fantasy. Because you don't play no better. You think you do. You think you do. But you ain't
playing no better. Because when you ain't smoking and have to go on and do the same thing, you just put your heart and soul into it.

If you're a person that wants to make good. And I've always been the type, no matter how I felt I would be on stage when it was time for me to go on. I'd be all nervous before I go on, but when I got out there I done my work. And that's probably where I got the name from.
You used to smoke yourself, though, right?
No, I smoked pot anywhere I went. I knew I was going to be safe doing it.

Until I got busted. And then I quit. I said if this is what has to happen to me, and serve these 45 days for just a little cigarette I had, shame on them. And I quit. Especially when I started having my family, I said uh-uh. Nothing for me no more. Do you blame me?
It's like here comes trouble, you know?

Yeah. I thought I had got rid of one of the roaches I had in my pocket when the police took me in. I thought I had got rid of it in the place. And put my hand in my pocket and here was a little roach in my pocket. And what I done was just thrown it on the floor as I walked. And they was looking ahead so fast, following -- not following behind, because they had us by the arm, you know?
And I just dropped it. I don't know who found it, but I know I dropped what I had.
And this was here in Los Angeles. Boy, they used to be rough on you, they really did. I found out how rough they was and I quit, period.
Yeah. 45 days. Just on a little roach. Ain't that some shit? Cold, boy. Now I hear they're giving it out free, ain't they, some of it?
